summary: Humanity’s Journey to Space Begins in Qazaqstan. Now it is time for the whole world to learn space from Qazaqstan. Space traveling and exploration can be organized in the way humanity hasn’t imagined before. We should dive into our philosophy, cosmology and culture and enrich our Spase and Astronaut Mission and all the related games and simulators with our authentic worldview, use our ethnic design and accompany the music accompaniment with dombra. Astronaut Mission Trainers and Space Mission Games will use our authentic words in our original scripts. Balance of power, Turkic cosmology, space exploration with care about the world with broader meaning of space as our home — all these will make space exploration from Qazaqstan unique. Indigenous knowledge in Space is essential for anywhere in the world. Traveling from Americas also requires implementation of Native American philosophy, values and worldview. Turkic Nomadic people such as Qazaqs and Tatars and Native Americas have common ancestors and common philosophy. I managed to find projects of NASA connected with Native Americans but there are no projects yet with Qazaq, Turkic and Eurasian Nomad worldview. Glad to be a pioneer in this vision.
details:
My project offers a new perspective on how Space Exploration can be made. No one has done it earlier. If the project will be realized, it will bring the new breath to Space exploration.

For my project I used HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

The highest value provided in my project is its philosophy and vision. I believe no one else came up with these ideas or their implementation. I focused on the values.
